title: Scaffold workspace, new crate stubs, capture v1 fixture
interfaces: FIRST step, before any other change: on the untouched M0 code, temporarily add crates/lab-core/examples/dump_demo_v1.rs (prints lab_core::sample::demo_document().to_json().unwrap()), run it with cargo run -p lab-core --example dump_demo_v1 --offline, save stdout to crates/lab-core/tests/fixtures/demo_v1.json, then delete the example. Root Cargo.toml: members += crates/lab-geom, crates/lab-file. [workspace.dependencies] += lab-geom = { path = "crates/lab-geom" }, lab-file = { path = "crates/lab-file" }, flate2 = "1.1". Add [profile.dev.package.lab-core] opt-level = 2 and [profile.dev.package.lab-geom] opt-level = 2. lab-geom/Cargo.toml: glam, thiserror (workspace). lab-file/Cargo.toml: lab-core, serde, serde_json, thiserror, flate2 (workspace); [dev-dependencies] tempfile = "3". lab-core += lab-geom. lab-viewport += lab-geom. lab-app += lab-geom, lab-file, serde_json. T0 must NOT create lab-app/src/lib.rs. Because a [lib] path without the file breaks the build, T0 adds the [lib] section (path = "src/lib.rs", name lab_app) commented out with a TODO(T6a) marker, and T6a is allowed to uncomment it (sole exception to ownership, a one-line change). windows-sys features become ["Win32_Foundation", "Win32_Graphics_Dwm", "Win32_UI_Controls_Dialogs", "Win32_System_Com"]. lab-geom/src/lib.rs and lab-file/src/lib.rs are stubs with only a //! doc comment.
acceptance: The fixture exists, is valid JSON with schema_version 1, and was generated from M0 code (record the commit hash in the commit message). cargo build --workspace --offline succeeds. cargo build -v shows no 'Compiling bevy_' lines (no Bevy rebuild). Cargo.lock gains no new external packages (git diff Cargo.lock adds only lab-geom and lab-file). scripts/check-offline.ps1 passes with 419 + 2 runtime crates. All 22 M0 tests still pass.

title: Hole shader spike: WESL ExtendedMaterial with presence mask
interfaces: Work in a scratch git worktree of the M0 commit (for example D:\Try\LabSetup-spike, outside the repo), wired into M0's scene.rs top surface with a hand-built quad mesh whose UV_0 is platform-local mm. Deliver only the two files into the repo, unwired (T4b adds 'mod hole_material;'). API exactly as in spec §5.5: MAX_ZONES, HOLE_GRID_SHADER (uuid_handle!), HoleGridParams (ShaderType; field order must match the WESL struct), HoleGridExt (#[uniform(100)], #[texture(101)] #[sampler(102)]), HoleTopMaterial, HoleGridPlugin (synchronous Assets<Shader>::insert + MaterialPlugin), HoleMask, build_mask(cols, rows, present), mask_image, GridGeometry, ZoneParam, hole_params, shade_cpu. No lab-core dependency inside these files. Tests live in a #[cfg(test)] module inside hole_material.rs.
acceptance: In the spike worktree: the app shows crisp holes on the M0 table, with an L-shaped test mask and one circle zone (show_zones=1), at 0.05 m, 0.3 m, 1 m, 5 m and 40 m in both 3D and Top (PrintWindow screenshots attached to the commit message or docs). No visible shimmer while orbiting. A full-resolution frame takes no more than M0 +5% at 1440x900 (LABSETUP_TRACE). Idle is 0.00% CPU/GPU after spawning. The mask tests and the shade_cpu energy and no-pop tests from spec §5.9 pass in the worktree (cargo test -p lab-viewport). If the shader cannot be made to work, implement fallback (a) or (b) from risk R1 and report which was used and why.

title: lab-ui: types, fields, inspectors, overlays, AppWindow API, gallery
interfaces: Exactly spec §6. Structs (SceneRow with kind, LibraryRow, InspectorField, EditField, CornerRow, ZoneRow, DoorRow, WallChoice, OutlinePreview without px-per-unit, PreviewLabel, PresetRow) are defined in the leaf file ui/types.slint, imported by fields/inspector/overlays/app, and re-exported from app.slint with `export { ... } from "types.slint";` (never defined in app.slint: that causes 'Recursive import'; never export non-Window components from app.slint). The EditState and TableFocus globals live in fields.slint. NumberField / TextField contract: no binding of text, the no-op rule on Enter, blur via EditState.focus-viewport, committed(id, text) -> bool, edited, focused. CornerTable, ZoneList, DoorList, PreviewCard (every Path shares one stroke-width of 1.5px and the inset-aware label maths of §6.1, using a 150px - stroke square centred horizontally, not the card width), Sheet (own sheet-keys FocusScope focused on open, Return/Escape in key-pressed, focus back to the viewport on close), Toast, ProjectMenu, PresetMenu, PasteSheet (multi-line text area; Ctrl+Return applies and Escape cancels via a capture FocusScope; Enter inserts a newline). SegmentedControl is controlled: `in property <int> current`, the click only emits selected(i); M0 view-mode uses `current: root.view-mode; selected(i) => { root.view-mode = i; root.view-mode-requested(i); }`. Every AppWindow property and callback listed in §6.3 (choice properties are `in` and bound one-way; has-selection and frame-all() are removed; scene-row-clicked(int, int)), with the field, choice and action id strings of §6.3. Toolbar undo/redo tooltips use the built-in Tooltip with `text: @markdown("\{root.undo-label}")` (at most one Tooltip per element). The root 'shortcuts' FocusScope capture-key-pressed table and the focus-tick to keys.focus() wiring of §6.4; viewport keys check Shift+F (event.modifiers.shift) before plain F. No std-widgets inside the inspector (Flickable instead); ListView stays for the scene list.
acceptance: cargo build -p lab-ui --offline has no warnings (no recursive imports, no 'Exported component ... doesn't inherit Window'). cargo run -p lab-ui --example gallery shows the six states (keys 1-6) at 1440x900 and 960x620 (screenshots). In the gallery: Enter on an unchanged field does not call field-committed; Ctrl+Z with a clean focused field calls action('edit.undo'); Ctrl+Z after typing in a field does text undo instead; Enter in a corner cell moves to the next row; Shift+F calls view.frame_selection and F calls view.frame_all; a choice that the mock refuses leaves the SegmentedControl thumb where it was, and setting the property from Rust afterwards still moves it; with a sheet open, Return/Escape reach the sheet even if a field had focus before it opened, and focus returns to the viewport on close; in PasteSheet Enter inserts a newline and Ctrl+Return applies (or, if capture ordering fails, the documented fallback); PreviewCard labels sit on their corners within 1 px at both window sizes; tooltips show the undo/redo labels.
